data.name: Masterpiece 8K photorealistic portrait of a beautiful ancient Chinese young woman in Honor of Kings
data.description: Masterpiece 8K photorealistic portrait of a beautiful ancient Chinese young woman in Honor of Kings art style. Red cinnabar mole on forehead, tear crystal under eye, red winged eyeliner, plump red lips, fair skin with realistic texture. Deep black double bun hair with red ribbons, golden hair ornaments with turquoise beads and silver tassels. Off-shoulder cyan and wine red Hanfu dress, layered translucent gauze sleeves, golden embroidery, flowing fabric. Red string wrapped around right wrist with ancient copper coins, right hand raised in seal gesture, left hand at chest. Floating copper coins in air. Dark misty immortal realm background, golden dust particles, red petals. Cinematic side backlighting, golden rim light, dramatic shadows, shallow depth of field, bokeh, vertical half body portrait, 85mm lens.

data.description: Chinese ink wash painting meets modern. A lone figure stands on a wild ridge under heavy clouds, brush-stroke style.
